title: The Far Provision
premise: Theo Blackwood, a storm chaser drowning in debt to the Vane Syndicate, is hired by her old rival Imogen Reyes for an illegal salvage run up the Kestrel River — a route Theo's late mentor swore off after a disaster that killed two of their crew. The prize is a wrecked expedition plane carrying the inheritance of a dead whistleblower, evidence that could topple the Syndicate itself. Racing the calving season, Theo and a ragtag found family of misfits fight rapids, betrayal, and their own buried grief, discovering the 'forbidden source' hides both the wreckage and the truth about who betrayed them twenty years ago. In the end, Theo chooses justice over the payout, exposing the Syndicate at the cost of the salvage — and finally learns to measure life in years, not miles.
about_author: Xanthe Nakamura is a former river guide who spent a decade leading expeditions through glacial fjords before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure stories about people who find family in the wildest, most unforgiving places on earth.

chapters.title: Miles, Not Years
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Chasing a supercell across the plains to earn quick money, she calculates debts owed to the Vane Syndicate and counts the miles since she last went home. A telegram-style message arrives from Imogen Reyes, the rival she hasn't spoken to in twenty years. Emotional beat: restless avoidance cracking open.

chapters.title: The Optimist's Ledger
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. She meets with Vane enforcer Cassius Bell, who smiles too warmly while reminding her what happens to debtors who run. The job offer from Imogen could clear everything — if she takes it. Emotional beat: dread dressed as opportunity.

chapters.title: A Rival's Terms
chapters.summary: Imogen's POV. In a dockside bar, Imogen lays out the job: salvage a 2004 wreck upriver before calving season seals the route. She knows about the sworn-off promise and doesn't apologize for asking. Emotional beat: old wounds reopened by mutual respect.

chapters.title: Crew of Strays
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo assembles her crew: engineer Jun Park, navigator Odile, teenage deckhand Sparrow, and cook Big Marisol — each owing something or running from something. The chapter builds the fragile found-family dynamic. Emotional beat: wary belonging.

chapters.title: The Sworn-Off Water
chapters.summary: Jun's POV. Loading the boat, Jun finds Theo's old journal page about the 2004 disaster and asks nothing, but watches her burn it. The crew launches at dawn past the last legal marker buoy. Emotional beat: crossing a line together.

chapters.title: First Rapids
chapters.summary: Sparrow's POV. The greenest crew member narrates the first white-knuckle run through the Narrows, where Theo's competence becomes legend and trust begins to form. Emotional beat: awe turning into loyalty.

chapters.title: What the River Remembers
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Navigating by half-buried markers from the old expedition, Odile realizes someone has been through recently — fresh rope cuts, a stripped cache. They are not alone on the river. Emotional beat: unease sharpening into vigilance.

chapters.title: Bell's Shadow
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. A Syndicate patrol boat appears downstream; Theo realizes Cassius Bell fed Imogen's route to Vane. They hide in a side channel overnight, and Marisol's stories around the fire knit the crew closer. Emotional beat: the enemy revealed, the family hardened.

chapters.title: Imogen's Confession
chapters.summary: Imogen's POV. Trapped by weather, Imogen admits the wreck carries evidence her own father planted — he was the whistleblower the Syndicate killed, and she needs it to clear his name. Emotional beat: rivalry dissolving into shared grief.

chapters.title: The Portage Nobody Talks About
chapters.summary: Jun's POV. The crew hauls the boat over a brutal mountain portage; Jun's hands are ruined, and Sparrow quietly takes his share without being asked. Emotional beat: sacrifice as love language.

chapters.title: Icefield Light
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Above the tree line, the glacier country opens — beautiful and lethal. Theo tells Jun the truth of 2004: she froze during the disaster, and her mentor took the blame. Emotional beat: guilt spoken aloud at last.

chapters.title: The Turncoat
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile catches Sparrow radioing coordinates to Bell — not for money, but because Vane holds Sparrow's brother. Confronted, Sparrow breaks down; the crew votes to keep her aboard. Emotional beat: mercy as a choice, not naivety.

chapters.title: Calving Season Opens Early
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. A distant thunderclap: the glacier has begun to calve ahead of schedule. The window is collapsing. They push through the night, running rapids blind under headlamps. Emotional beat: desperation fused with resolve.

chapters.title: The Source
chapters.summary: Imogen's POV. They reach the forbidden source lake beneath the glacier wall and find the wreck — and Bell's camp already there, waiting. Bell offers Theo her debt erased for the evidence alone. Emotional beat: temptation at its most human.

chapters.title: Twenty Years of Miles
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo refuses, and Bell takes the crew hostage, revealing he engineered the whole job to flush out the whistleblower's proof. Theo recognizes the trap's architecture — the same one that doomed the 2004 expedition. Emotional beat: the past repeating until she breaks it.

chapters.title: Glacier's Verdict
chapters.summary: Sparrow's POV. A massive calving splits the ice shelf; in the chaos, Sparrow uses her knowledge of Bell's operation to free the crew as the source lake begins to drain catastrophically. Emotional beat: redemption earned in motion.

chapters.title: The Long Drop
chapters.summary: Jun's POV. The crew races the flood down the drainage channel they came up, the evidence canister lashed to the hull. Jun nearly drowns saving the documents; Odile pulls him out. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into devotion.

chapters.title: Downstream of Everything
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Below the gorge, they intercept Bell's extraction helicopter pad and broadcast the whistleblower files to every news outlet within range before Bell can stop them. Justice lands outside any courtroom. Emotional beat: triumph with blood price.

chapters.title: What We Salvaged
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Wrecked boat, empty pockets, but whole. Marisol cooks a feast on the riverbank as the crew reckons with what they lost and kept — including Sparrow, whose brother is freed when the files go public. Emotional beat: grief and gratitude sharing a table.

chapters.title: Debts and Dividends
chapters.summary: Imogen's POV. With the Syndicate exposed, Vane's creditors turn on themselves; Theo's debt dies with the ledger. Imogen offers Theo a partnership — legitimate expeditions, no sworn-off waters. Emotional beat: rivalry become kinship.

chapters.title: Years, Not Miles
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo returns to the grave of her mentor upstream and reads his name aloud, forgiven at last by herself. She plants a new marker buoy at the old legal line — then sails past it anyway, freely this time. Emotional beat: release.

chapters.title: The Far Provision
chapters.summary: Sparrow's POV, one year later. The rebuilt crew launches a new season with new strays aboard; Sparrow, now navigator-in-training, logs the first mile. Theo measures the year behind her in birthdays, not odometer ticks. Emotional beat: home is the people aboard.
